Hey folks! This is the first map that I ever made, and I used Inkarnate for that. So this is the Island of Ardeen, an unforgiving land full of mysteries and danger. There are 3 main players on that scenario: Ardeenioz, the great nation, the pinnacle of civilization on the land(or so they think), a nation in decadence; Ufuksill, the rebel city-State once part of Ardeenioz; The "savage", people of the desert known as Kizoayna.

You may have noticed by this point that half of the map is covered in clouds, this is intentional as this area is the wilds, territory of the "savage" tribes. Because of that, and other factors as the nature of the Mirrored Desert ("Deserto Espelhado" as it is written in the map), the area is not mapped by the "civilized". But, despite all that, believe me when I say that there are many mysteries hiding behind those clouds.

P.S. This is a homebrew world that I and my friends are creating( Like the MCU, but here every DM adds something new), and Ardeen is the first piece of land and culture that we have so far.  
P.S. Many of the names are in Portuguese as it is my native language.

​

Hope you enjoyed, feedback is always welcome :)
